faq.question: What does Mazen mean?
faq.answer: Mazen is associated with the Arabic form مَازِن, whose core sense is mazen; rain clouds.

faq.answer: Mazen can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Mazen should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root م ز ن occurs in Quranic vocabulary for rain-clouds, but Māzin is not a Quranic personal name.
